Configuration.Description: Server-side tuning the behaviour of ovens.

Settings.Label: Oven heating, cooling, and baking rate
Settings.Description: Modifies the rate at which the oven heats, cools, and bakes.

Settings.Label: Fuel burn rate multiplier
Settings.Description: Multiplier applied to the burn rate of fuels.

Settings.Label: Bake rate multiplier
Settings.Description: Additional direct modifier to the baking rate. This does not affect heating or cooling time.
